import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
k = rng.integers(0, 4, 8000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 7, (4, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (8000, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['group'] = pd.Categorical(['North', 'South', 'East', 'West'][v] for v in k)
df.shape

steps.name: open annotate tab and label by group
steps.eval: document.querySelector('#tab-annotate').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const col = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'group').index; const sel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Label by"]'); sel.value = String(col); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }))

steps.name: compute screen position of the first label (page coordinates)
steps.eval: const lbl = a.renderer.labels[0]; window.__labelName = lbl.key ?? lbl.text; const wx = lbl.position[0]; const wy = lbl.position[1]; const sc = a.renderer.projectWorld(wx, wy); const canvas = document.querySelector('canvas'); const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__labelSX = sc ? Math.round(sc[0] + rect.left) : null; window.__labelSY = sc ? Math.round(sc[1] + rect.top) : null;
steps.report: { name: window.__labelName, sx: window.__labelSX, sy: window.__labelSY }

steps.name: drag the first label 80px to the right and 40px down
dragged label is at the offset position
steps.eval: const name = window.__labelName; const offset = a.labels.dragOffsets[name]; const lbl = a.renderer.labels.find(l => (l.key ?? l.text) === name); window.__offsetMatch = lbl && offset && Math.abs(lbl.position[0] - (a.renderer.labels.find(l2 => (l2.key ?? l2.text) === name)?.position[0] ?? 0)) >= 0
steps.report: { name: window.__labelName, offset: a.labels.dragOffsets[window.__labelName], renderedPos: a.renderer.labels.find(l => (l.key ?? l.text) === window.__labelName)?.position, pinnedCard: a.pinnedCard }

steps.name: dragged label still visible in export (pixels present)
steps.eval: const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] + d[i+1] + d[i+2] > 60) n++; window.__dragPixels = n

steps.name: B5: record world anchor and world offset before view changes
steps.eval: const lbl = a.renderer.labels.find(l => (l.key ?? l.text) === window.__labelName); const off = a.labels.dragOffsets[window.__labelName]; window.__anchorW = lbl ? [lbl.position[0] - (off ? off[0] : 0), lbl.position[1] - (off ? off[1] : 0)] : null; window.__labelPosW = lbl ? [lbl.position[0], lbl.position[1]] : null;

steps.name: B5: label world position unchanged after pan (map-coord invariant)
steps.eval: a.setView({ target: [a.view?.target?.[0] ?? 0 + 2, a.view?.target?.[1] ?? 0] }); await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r)));
steps.report: { lbl: a.renderer.labels.find(l => (l.key ?? l.text) === window.__labelName)?.position, expected: window.__labelPosW }

steps.name: B5: label world position unchanged after zoom (map-coord invariant)
steps.eval: a.setView({ zoom: (a.view?.zoom ?? 1) + 1 }); await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r)));
steps.report: { lbl: a.renderer.labels.find(l => (l.key ?? l.text) === window.__labelName)?.position, zoom: a.view?.zoom }

steps.name: B5: label world position unchanged after 2D rotation (map-coord invariant)
steps.eval: a.setRotation2D(45); await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r)));
steps.report: { lbl: a.renderer.labels.find(l => (l.key ?? l.text) === window.__labelName)?.position, rotation2D: a.rotation2D }

steps.name: reset all label positions via UI
steps.eval: const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Reset all label positions')); if (btn) btn.click()

steps.name: hidden labels are not pickable (CollisionFilterExtension)
steps.eval: const hiddenLabels = a.renderer.labels.filter(l => l.priority !== undefined); window.__allHaveKeys = hiddenLabels.every(l => l.key !== undefined || l.text !== undefined)
